input.description: Save carton-size change to the memory store

content.text:
`pack.py` now packs six units per carton. I reran it on `orders.csv`, and the revised report matches what I expected:

```
sku,units,cartons
birch_tea,2,1
cedar_mug,9,2
```

- **cedar_mug**: still 9 units, but now 9 ÷ 6 rounded up is 2 cartons (it was 3 with four-unit cartons).
- **birch_tea**: 2 units still fits in 1 carton.
- **Unchanged:** the order eligibility and SKU rules are the same, so p3 and p5 (on hold, including p5 with `approved=yes`) and p6 (cancelled) are still left out.

The only code change was `CARTON_SIZE = 6` in `pack.py`. The checks are the one-line assertion I run after each report, not a separate test file, so updating them meant changing the expected `cedar_mug` cartons to 2. That assertion passed. I also updated the project memory to record the switch to six-unit cartons, noting that four-unit cartons are obsolete.
